test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 24 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: An athlete is moving with uniform speed in a circular track of radius R., and he completes one round in t s. The speed of the athlete is:
solution:
**Given:**

Radius of the circular track = R

Time to complete one round = t seconds

**Formula Used:**

Speed = Distance / Time

Distance for one round in circular track = Circumference of the circle = 2πR

**Calculation:**

Distance = 2πR

Time = t seconds

Speed = Distance / Time

Speed = (2πR) / t

**∴ The speed of the athlete is (2πR) / t.**
